Shell.commandPaletteDescription: Search for a command to run...

Auth.signInTitle: Sign in or create your account
Auth.signInDescription: Build your own racers, shooters, puzzles and whole worlds using your own words.
Auth.signInCancelledDescription: You cancelled the sign-in. Pick a provider to try again.
Auth.signInExpiredDescription: The sign-in took too long or was opened in another tab. Please try again.
Auth.noEmailDescription: Your account did not share an email address with Numa. Allow email access or try another provider.
Auth.emailNotVerifiedDescription: Verify your email address with the provider, then try again.
Auth.accountAlreadyUsedDescription: This account is already linked to a different Numa user.
Auth.couldNotLinkDescription: Sign in with the provider you used the first time.
Auth.signInFailedDescription: Something went wrong while signing you in. Please try again.
Auth.enterAuthenticatorCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
Auth.enterRecoveryCode: Enter one of your recovery codes.
Auth.incorrectCodeDescription: That code didn't work. Try again.
Auth.attemptExpiredDescription: Your sign-in attempt expired. Sign in again.
Auth.accountLockedDescription: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
Auth.tooManyAttemptsDescription: Too many attempts. Wait a few seconds and try again.
